entities.summary: Sutradhar is a Bengali caste within the Vishwakarma community of West Bengal in Indian and in Bangladesh. Their traditional occupation is carpentry. The great majority of Hindu Sutradhars belong to the Vaishnava sect. Vishwakarma is regarded as their patron deity.
